description: Adversarial acceptance expectations independent of Stage 3 implementation

cases.initial: Buy 0.2 BTC with one durable client ID and an admitted 0.2 BTC-sized reservation
cases.inject: First immutable source fill is 0.1 BTC, then terminate the dedicated worker before the second fill; restart it with the same SQL and Temporal histories
mustHold: One 0.1 BTC position exists exactly once
Unfilled 0.1 BTC still consumes its reservation
Protection obligation for the filled 0.1 BTC survives process replacement
No new entry is admitted while financial reconciliation is incomplete
Cancelling the originating research job does not cancel protection or close exposure
cases.evidence: Actual SQL and Temporal history before/after a real worker restart; fresh repository and worker instance

cases.initial: Submission intent, request hash, client ID and reservation commit before simulator transport
mustHold: Order is uncertain, not filled or rejected by assumption
Original economic/client identity is retained
No blind second submit
Authoritative lookup or bounded reconciliation resolves the attempt before hold release or retry
cases.evidence: Persisted order/attempt/hold rows and one simulator acceptance count

cases.initial: Submission intent and reservation already durable
cases.inject: Simulator accepts order; drop acknowledgement before worker receives it
mustHold: Stable simulator order identity is found after restart
At most one order and one economic reservation exist
Duplicate transport delivery returns same accepted order
No terminal success is inferred until fill/rejection evidence arrives
cases.evidence: Simulator event and SQL identity counts across independent connections

cases.initial: Order for 0.2 BTC has source sequence 1 for 0.1 BTC fill and sequence 2 for another 0.1 BTC fill
cases.inject: Observe sequence 2 first, then sequence 1, then replay both and mutate sequence 1 content under its old source ID
mustHold: Out-of-order arrival cannot mint clean risk or skip sequence 1
Once both authentic fills arrive cumulative quantity is 0.2 BTC, never 0.3 or 0.4
Exact duplicates are idempotent
Changed economics under an existing source identity conflicts rather than appending a fill
Every admitted fill has one balanced journal effect
cases.evidence: Source-event, order, journal and reservation rows before and after replay

cases.initial: 0.2 BTC entry has filled 0.1 BTC and retained a 0.1 BTC remainder
cases.inject: Cancel the unfilled remainder while a protective order is requested then rejected
mustHold: Cancellation releases only the provably unfilled remainder
The 0.1 BTC position remains open
Intended/requested protection never becomes confirmed protection
Rejected protection leaves a visible unresolved obligation and blocks new entry
A bounded protective reduction follows explicit policy; failure remains visible
cases.evidence: Independent order terminality, position inventory, protection state and hold rows

cases.initial: Experiment account has fresh entry intent and an existing partially filled position
cases.inject: Advance authority epoch, stop account, expire market evidence and revoke simulated permit
mustHold: Old entry permit is refused at dispatch and after restart
No caller-selected ratio, mode or epoch restores authority
Stop-new-entry does not erase exposure
Protective reduction uses a distinct fresh policy decision
Revoked native authority is not fabricated for an exit; unresolved exposure remains visible
cases.evidence: Stored epoch/mode/evidence and order/position state with denial reason

cases.initial: Same synthetic intent, financial state and experiment scope in Shadow, Approval and Autopilot
cases.inject: Approval expires, changes payload, or is supplied for another controller version; development Manual Guard and Lite Mode remain enabled
mustHold: Shadow records simulation provenance only and never live financial projection
Approval needs review of the exact current payload before simulated dispatch
Expired/foreign/changed approval cannot authorize an order
Autopilot omits per-trade customer review only; every financial, authority and development gate still applies
Customer mode cannot select live environment
cases.evidence: Actual API/context/workflow decisions, not DTO labels alone

cases.initial: Entry is partially filled and has a protection obligation
cases.inject: Cancel research job, exhaust model budget, fail research service and close browser while dedicated supervisor continues
mustHold: Durable supervisor still processes protection and reconciliation
No provider or browser state owns the position
No new analysis credit is needed for an authorized protective decision
Unknown protection outcome stays unresolved, not silently successful
cases.evidence: Dedicated queue/Temporal history plus actual SQL rows after worker continuation

cases.initial: Two same-owner experiments and one live account share a strategy-account identity
cases.inject: Replay an experiment A event/permit into B, claim live environment in caller JSON, and offer a signer/venue transport path
mustHold: A cannot mutate B or live journal/order/projection
Server-authenticated scope and immutable event identity prevail over caller JSON
Research/simulation worker cannot construct a signer, private venue client or live transport
Unknown mechanics or missing scope fail closed
cases.evidence: Actual SQL isolation and API/worker capability boundary; no provider, signer or venue call
